test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which version of the skill development scheme, launched by the government and implemented from FY 2022 to 2026, aims to provide free training to rural youth in India?

options.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana 2.0

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)** is a flagship scheme launched by the Government of India, aimed at providing **free skill development training** to youth across India, especially in rural areas.
 
• The scheme is implemented from **FY 2022 to 2026**, focusing on equipping individuals with industry-relevant skills to enhance employability. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• PMKVY 4.0 emphasizes **digital skills**, aligning with the growing demand for technology-driven roles in the job market.
 
• The scheme targets **rural youth**, ensuring inclusivity by bridging the skill gaps in remote areas. It also focuses on marginalized groups, such as women and economically disadvantaged communities. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• PMKVY 4.0 incorporates an extensive network of **training centers** across India, including partnerships with industries, organizations, and state governments to ensure effective implementation.
 
• The scheme is part of the government's **Skill India Mission**, aimed at achieving the larger goal of transforming India into the "Skill Capital of the World." *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Skill Development Schemes in India:**

 
 
• **Skill India Mission**: Launched in **2015**, it aims to train over **40 crore people** in India in different skills by 2022.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY):** This scheme has seen multiple iterations, with PMKVY 4.0 being the latest, designed to meet current industry demands and empower youth.
 
 
 
• **Features of PMKVY 4.0:**
 
 
• Focuses on **industry-relevant training**, including digital, green, and emerging technologies.
 
• Provides **certification** and placement assistance to trainees.
 
• Encourages participation from **women, minorities, and differently-abled individuals** for equitable growth.
 
 
 
• **Other Skill Development Schemes:**
 
 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY):** Focuses on rural youth aged 15-35, providing skill training to boost employment in rural areas.
 
• **Skill India 3.0:** Focuses on digital literacy and upskilling existing workers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **PMKVY 4.0 Implementation:**

 
 
• Implemented by **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)** with the help of **National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC).**
 
• Focuses on creating a robust ecosystem for skill training and certification.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Addressed:**
 
 
• Bridges the gap between **education and employment** by emphasizing practical training.
 
• Addresses the issue of **unemployment** in rural and semi-urban regions.
